### Praying with Confidence Because God Answers
Author: Sarah Frazer
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/praying-with-confidence-because-god-answers-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Mark 11:24
Points:
- God is an attentive Father who never tires and consistently listens to the cries of His children.
- The power of prayer depends entirely on the character of God rather than the size of human faith.
- When prayers seem unanswered or dreams fade, believers are urged to trust God's presence and timing.
- Christians can approach God with confidence, bringing both everyday needs and monumental concerns to Him.

### Believing Prayer
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/believing-prayer
Passage: Mark 11:20-24
Points:
- Jesus was not astonished by the withered tree, showing that believers should expect God to answer faith-filled prayers.
- Continual shock when prayers are answered can reveal an underlying doubt in God's reliability.
- Jesus' promise must be understood alongside Scripture's wider teaching on praying according to God's will.
- True faith rests in the Lord Himself and humbly accepts His decisions when He declines a request.
